enchantments.tooltip: Negative Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming negative energy healing by +15 (Insight bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Insightful Light Resistance +13: Passive: +13 Insight bonus to your Light Resistance.
Vitality +24: Passive: +24 Vitality bonus to Hit Points.
Magical Efficiency 10%: You take a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of your spells.

Curse Necromancer: 2 Pieces Equipped:+5 Artifact bonus to Negative Amplification.Whenever you cast a Negative or Poison spell, you have a chance to apply a stack of Dreadful Curse, reducing the enemy's fortitude by 1. This can stack up to 3 times, and each stack lasts 30 seconds.
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
